interest: Wartime League of Nations drug report on dagga eradication and motor-car smuggling in colonial Basutoland.
overview: League of Nations document of June 18, 1942 giving Basutoland's 1941 drug report: dagga was the only illicit drug, with 78 prosecutions and nearly 1,700 pounds destroyed.

subfiles.about: League of Nations annual report for 1941 regarding the regulation and control of traffic in dangerous drugs and dagga (Indian hemp) in Basutoland.
subfiles.from: Acting Secretary-General of the League of Nations
subfiles.summary: Basutoland's 1941 opium and dangerous drugs report to the League of Nations. The only illicit drug was wild dagga, smuggled by car into South Africa; there were 78 prosecutions and over 1,695 pounds destroyed.
subfiles.title: Traffic in Opium and Other Dangerous Drugs: Annual Reports by Governments for 1941 - Basutoland
subfiles.to: Council and Members of the League of Nations
